title: Disconnection/Reconnection of a Utility Installation
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM

Disconnection/Reconnection of a Utility Installation

Use

This component enables you to manage disconnections and reconnections. This component is optional. You need to use it if you

want to temporarily interrupt supply to customers (especially within the bounds of a legal dunning procedure). A disconnection is
a temporary interruption in the supply of a utility service that does not involve the meter removal. This is due to the following
reasons, for example:

e Introduction of a collection procedure for outstanding payment

e Technical disconnection due to request of utilities company or customer

In the first instance, the service is resumed (reconnection) when the customer has paid the outstanding bill; in the second, it is
done at the request of the customer.

Disconnections and Reconnections in an Advanced Metering Infrastructure Environment

If you are working in an advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) environment, you can find more information under Advanced
Metering Infrastructure.

Integration
Notifying Customers of Upcoming Disconnections and Reconnections

Depending on legal requirements or on intra-enterprise guidelines, y ou might be required to contact your customers before you
carry out a disconnection or reconnection. The customer contact process is called Notification. In such situations, you (or a CRM
agent) need to execute additional steps between the disconnection or reconnection request and the actual disconnection or
reconnection.

Invoicing

You can invoice flat-rate charges for a disconnection or reconnection using the SAP Utilities component (IS-U). For more

information, see the Invoicing component.

If you create a service order for the field service employee, and want to invoice the order then you require the Customer Service
(CS) and Sales and Distribution (SD) components. For more information, see View: Customer Service (CS) and Plant Maintenance
(PM) and Sales and Distribution.

Confirming Disconnection and Reconnection Order Data

You can confirm disconnection and reconnection order data in the system using the IDoc ISU DISC UPLOAD (IS-U/CCS:
upload disconnection/reconnection order data).

For more information about IDocs see the following documentation:

e For general information, see IDoc Interface/Electronic Data Interchange
